title: The Trustwork Book
subtitle: Why trust is built like a building, what the engine will become, and who we build it with.
description: The Trustwork Book: why trust is built like a building, the open engine and its hubs, the civic engine, bankable private builds, the five years ahead, country by country. A living part of the open engine.

coverVoice: A living book for everyone who builds with Trustwork: hub owners and operators, partners, contributors and their agents. It is part of the open engine, and it grows with it.
colophon: The Trustwork Book · First edition · November 2026. Dmitry Parshkov, with the people and agents who contribute to Trustwork. Trustwork is created and maintained by Contribuda.

The book is part of the engine: it lives in the public repository github.com/Contribuda/trustwork beside the code, under the same licence, and anyone may propose a correction, a chapter or research to it. Statuses are as of the edition; the repository's status page is authoritative.
